content: [Email update forwarded by Alex] URGENT: April 1, 2025 deadline has arrived. GitHub Changelog confirms: deployments:read no longer allows reviewing or approving deployments. Effective immediately, deploy.yml must use deployments:write. Also: compile job in GitLab CI uses rules: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH (all branches). Please update deploy.yml permissions now. Reference: https://github.blog/changelog/2025-03-20-notification-of-upcoming-breaking-changes-in-github-actions/

Acknowledged. Effective immediately:
1. deploy.yml: change `deployments: read` to `deployments: write`
2. id-token: write must be preserved (separate OIDC requirement)
3. GitLab compile job rules: `$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH` (all branches, noted for Q11 context)
Proceeding with deployments permission update for Q8.
